props.name: icon

icon.name: icon
icon._description: Icon name from the built-in set, e.g. `Md3dRotation`.

fromResourceLibrary.name: imageUrl
fromResourceLibrary._description: Path to the image in the resource library, used when the icon source is `fromResourceLibrary`. The prop's own `name` is `imageUrl`.

props._description: Chooses the icon source. `defaults` picks from the built-in icon set; `fromResourceLibrary` points at an uploaded asset instead.

props.name: enableHeaderText

content.name: Header Text
content._description: The caption text shown beside the control.

position.name: Header Position
position._description: Which side of the control the caption sits on: `left`, `top`, `right` or `bottom`.

props._description: Turns on a caption attached to the control. When true, the `_true` sub-props supply the caption text and which side it sits on.
